import Mathlib

-- Precondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_precond (s : Array UInt8) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start precond
  s.size ≤ 1000000
  -- !benchmark @end precond

-- !benchmark @start auxcode
namespace Manacher

/-! ### Small array access helpers -/

theorem getD_lt {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : i < a.size) :
    a.getD i d = a[i] := by
  first
  | exact Array.getD_eq_getElem a d h
  | exact Array.getD_eq_getElem a h d
  | simp [Array.getD, h]
  | simp [Array.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, Array.getElem?_eq_getElem h]

theorem getD_ge {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (d : α) (h : a.size ≤ i) :
    a.getD i d = d := by
  first
  | simp [Array.getD, Nat.not_lt.2 h]
  | simp [Array.getD_eq_getElem?_getD, Array.getElem?_eq_none h]
  | simp [Array.getD, Nat.not_lt_of_ge h]

theorem getElem?_lt {α : Type} (a : Array α) (i : Nat) (h : i < a.size) :
    a[i]? = some a[i] := by
  first
  | exact Array.getElem?_eq_getElem h
  | exact getElem?_pos a i h
  | simp [h]

/-! ### Step (1): the separator-augmented sequence

`T = # s0 # s1 # … # s_{n-1} #`, where the separator is `none`.  Using `Option UInt8`
guarantees that the separator is really *unique*, i.e. it can never coincide with a
character of `s`. -/

def mkT (s : Array UInt8) : Array (Option UInt8) :=
  Array.ofFn (n := 2 * s.size + 1) fun i => if i.val % 2 = 1 then s[i.val / 2]? else none

theorem size_mkT (s : Array UInt8) : (mkT s).size = 2 * s.size + 1 := by
  simp [mkT]

theorem get_mkT (s : Array UInt8) (x : Nat) (hx : x < 2 * s.size + 1) :
    (mkT s).getD x none = if x % 2 = 1 then s[x / 2]? else none := by
  have h : x < (mkT s).size := by rw [size_mkT]; exact hx
  rw [getD_lt _ _ _ h]
  simp [mkT]

theorem mkT_even (s : Array UInt8) (x : Nat) (hx : x < 2 * s.size + 1) (h2 : x % 2 = 0) :
    (mkT s).getD x none = none := by
  rw [get_mkT s x hx, if_neg (by omega)]

theorem mkT_odd (s : Array UInt8) (x : Nat) (hx : x < 2 * s.size + 1) (h2 : x % 2 = 1) :
    (mkT s).getD x none = some (s.getD (x / 2) 0) := by
  rw [get_mkT s x hx, if_pos h2]
  have hlt : x / 2 < s.size := by omega
  rw [getElem?_lt _ _ hlt, getD_lt _ _ _ hlt]

/-! ### Palindromes of `T` -/

/-- `Pal T i r` : the palindrome of radius `r` centred at index `i` of `T` fits inside `T`
and is symmetric. -/
def Pal (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i r : Nat) : Prop :=
  r ≤ i ∧ i + r < T.size ∧ ∀ j, j ≤ r → T.getD (i - j) none = T.getD (i + j) none

theorem pal_zero (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i : Nat) (h : i < T.size) : Pal T i 0 := by
  refine ⟨Nat.zero_le _, by omega, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have : j = 0 := by omega
  subst this
  simp

theorem pal_mono {T : Array (Option UInt8)} {i r : Nat} (h : Pal T i r) {j : Nat}
    (hj : j ≤ r) : Pal T i j :=
  ⟨by have := h.1; omega, by have := h.2.1; omega, fun k hk => h.2.2 k (by omega)⟩

theorem pal_step {T : Array (Option UInt8)} {i r : Nat} (h : Pal T i r)
    (h1 : r + 1 ≤ i) (h2 : i + (r + 1) < T.size)
    (h3 : T.getD (i - (r + 1)) none = T.getD (i + (r + 1)) none) : Pal T i (r + 1) := by
  refine ⟨h1, h2, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (r + 1) with hj' | hj'
  · exact h.2.2 j (by omega)
  · have : j = r + 1 := by omega
    subst this
    exact h3

/-- Symmetry of a palindrome, stated for an arbitrary position inside it. -/
theorem pal_sym {T : Array (Option UInt8)} {C r : Nat} (h : Pal T C r) {x : Nat}
    (h1 : C ≤ x + r) (h2 : x ≤ C + r) :
    T.getD x none = T.getD (2 * C - x) none := by
  have hrC : r ≤ C := h.1
  rcases Nat.lt_or_ge x C with hx | hx
  · have e1 : C - (C - x) = x := by omega
    have e2 : C + (C - x) = 2 * C - x := by omega
    have := h.2.2 (C - x) (by omega)
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    exact this
  · have e1 : C - (x - C) = 2 * C - x := by omega
    have e2 : C + (x - C) = x := by omega
    have := h.2.2 (x - C) (by omega)
    rw [e1, e2] at this
    exact this.symm

/-! ### Step (4): expansion around a centre -/

/-- Expand the palindrome centred at `i` starting from radius `p`, while the characters
just outside match. -/
def expand (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i : Nat) (p : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : p + 1 ≤ i ∧ i + (p + 1) < T.size ∧
         T.getD (i - (p + 1)) none = T.getD (i + (p + 1)) none then
    expand T i (p + 1)
  else p
termination_by T.size - p
decreasing_by
  have h1 := h.2.1
  omega

/-- The maximal palindromic radius at centre `i`. -/
def maxrad (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i : Nat) : Nat := expand T i 0

/-! ### Steps (2), (3), (5): the main scan -/

/-- The radius `P[i]` is initialised from the mirror centre `2*C - i` when `i < R`. -/
def initRad (P : Array Nat) (C R i : Nat) : Nat :=
  if i < R then min (R - i) (P.getD (2 * C - i) 0) else 0

def setAt (P : Array Nat) (i : Nat) (v : Nat) : Array Nat :=
  if h : i < P.size then P.set i v h else P

theorem size_setAt (P : Array Nat) (i v : Nat) : (setAt P i v).size = P.size := by
  unfold setAt
  split <;> simp

theorem getD_setAt_same (P : Array Nat) (i v : Nat) (h : i < P.size) :
    (setAt P i v).getD i 0 = v := by
  unfold setAt
  rw [dif_pos h, getD_lt _ _ _ (by simpa using h)]
  first
  | simp
  | simp [Array.getElem_set_self]
  | simp [Array.getElem_set]

theorem getD_setAt_ne (P : Array Nat) (i v k : Nat) (h : k ≠ i) :
    (setAt P i v).getD k 0 = P.getD k 0 := by
  unfold setAt
  split
  · next hi =>
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k P.size with hk | hk
    · rw [getD_lt _ _ _ (by simpa using hk), getD_lt _ _ _ hk]
      first
      | (simp [h]; exact fun he => absurd he.symm h)
      | simp [h]
      | simp [Array.getElem_set_ne, h]
    · rw [getD_ge _ _ _ (by simpa using hk), getD_ge _ _ _ hk]
  · rfl

/-- The main loop of Manacher's algorithm: `P` holds the already computed radii, `C` and
`R` are the centre and right boundary of the rightmost-reaching palindrome found so far,
and `i` is the centre currently being processed. -/
def loop (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (P : Array Nat) (C R i : Nat) : Array Nat :=
  if h : i < T.size then
    if R < i + expand T i (initRad P C R i) then
      loop T (setAt P i (expand T i (initRad P C R i))) i
        (i + expand T i (initRad P C R i)) (i + 1)
    else
      loop T (setAt P i (expand T i (initRad P C R i))) C R (i + 1)
  else P
termination_by T.size - i
decreasing_by
  · omega
  · omega

/-! ### Step (6): result extraction -/

/-- Scan `P` from index `j` keeping the index of the largest radius seen. -/
def bestOf (P : Array Nat) (j b : Nat) : Nat :=
  if h : j < P.size then
    bestOf P (j + 1) (if P.getD b 0 < P.getD j 0 then j else b)
  else b
termination_by P.size - j
decreasing_by omega

def solve (s : Array UInt8) : Nat × Nat :=
  let T := mkT s
  let P := loop T (Array.ofFn (n := T.size) fun _ => (0 : Nat)) 0 0 0
  let b := bestOf P 0 0
  ((b - P.getD b 0) / 2, P.getD b 0)

end Manacher
-- !benchmark @end auxcode

-- Main function definitions
def longest_palindromic_substring (s : Array UInt8)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) :
    Nat × Nat :=
  -- !benchmark @start code
  Manacher.solve s
  -- !benchmark @end code

-- Helper definitions
def is_valid_subrange (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  start + len ≤ s.size

-- A sequence slice s[start, start+len) is a palindrome if for all i < len,
-- s[start + i] == s[start + len - 1 - i]
def is_palindrome_slice (s : Array UInt8) (start len : Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ i, i < len → s.getD (start + i) 0 = s.getD (start + len - 1 - i) 0

-- Postcondition definitions
@[reducible, simp]
def longest_palindromic_substring_postcond
    (s : Array UInt8) (result : Nat × Nat)
    (_ : longest_palindromic_substring_precond s) : Prop :=
  -- !benchmark @start postcond
  let (start, len) := result
  is_valid_subrange s start len ∧
  is_palindrome_slice s start len ∧
  (∀ i l, is_valid_subrange s i l → is_palindrome_slice s i l → l ≤ len)
  -- !benchmark @end postcond

-- !benchmark @start lemma
namespace Manacher

/-! ### Correctness of the expansion -/

theorem expand_spec_aux (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i : Nat) :
    ∀ n p, T.size - p ≤ n → Pal T i p →
      Pal T i (expand T i p) ∧ ∀ r, Pal T i r → r ≤ expand T i p := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro p hn hp
    exact absurd hp.2.1 (by omega)
  | succ n ih =>
    intro p hn hp
    rw [expand]
    split
    · next h =>
      exact ih (p + 1) (by have := h.2.1; omega) (pal_step hp h.1 h.2.1 h.2.2)
    · next h =>
      refine ⟨hp, fun r hr => ?_⟩
      by_contra hlt
      push_neg at hlt
      exact h ⟨by have := hr.1; omega, by have := hr.2.1; omega, hr.2.2 (p + 1) (by omega)⟩

theorem maxrad_spec (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i : Nat) (h : i < T.size) :
    Pal T i (maxrad T i) ∧ ∀ r, Pal T i r → r ≤ maxrad T i :=
  expand_spec_aux T i T.size 0 (by omega) (pal_zero T i h)

theorem expand_eq_maxrad (T : Array (Option UInt8)) (i p : Nat) (hp : Pal T i p) :
    expand T i p = maxrad T i := by
  have h1 := expand_spec_aux T i T.size p (by omega) hp
  have hi : i < T.size := by have := hp.2.1; omega
  have h2 := maxrad_spec T i hi
  exact Nat.le_antisymm (h2.2 _ h1.1) (h1.2 _ h2.1)

/-! ### The mirror initialisation is a valid radius -/

theorem pal_mirror {T : Array (Option UInt8)} {C R i : Nat}
    (hC : Pal T C (R - C)) (hCR : C ≤ R) (hCi : C < i) (hiR : i < R)
    (hmir : Pal T (2 * C - i) (maxrad T (2 * C - i))) :
    Pal T i (min (R - i) (maxrad T (2 * C - i))) := by
  have hrC : R - C ≤ C := hC.1
  have hR2C : R ≤ 2 * C := by omega
  have hRs : C + (R - C) < T.size := hC.2.1
  have hRs' : R < T.size := by omega
  refine ⟨by omega, by omega, fun j hj => ?_⟩
  have hj1 : j ≤ R - i := le_trans hj (min_le_left _ _)
  have hj2 : j ≤ maxrad T (2 * C - i) := le_trans hj (min_le_right _ _)
  have e1 : T.getD (i - j) none = T.getD (2 * C - (i - j)) none :=
    pal_sym hC (by omega) (by omega)
  have e2 : T.getD (i + j) none = T.getD (2 * C - (i + j)) none :=
    pal_sym hC (by omega) (by omega)
  have e3 : T.getD (2 * C - i - j) none = T.getD (2 * C - i + j) none := hmir.2.2 j hj2
  have q1 : 2 * C - (i - j) = 2 * C - i + j := by omega
  have q2 : 2 * C - (i + j) = 2 * C - i - j := by omega
  rw [e1, q1, ← e3, ← q2, ← e2]

/-! ### Correctness of the main loop -/

theorem loop_spec (T : Array (Option UInt8)) :
    ∀ n P C R i, T.size - i ≤ n → P.size = T.size →
      (∀ k, k < i → P.getD k 0 = maxrad T k) →
      Pal T C (R - C) → C ≤ R → (C < i ∨ (C = 0 ∧ R = 0)) →
      (loop T P C R i).size = T.size ∧
        ∀ k, k < T.size → (loop T P C R i).getD k 0 = maxrad T k := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro P C R i hn hsz hinv _ _ _
    rw [loop, dif_neg (by omega)]
    exact ⟨hsz, fun k hk => hinv k (by omega)⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro P C R i hn hsz hinv hC hCR hCi
    rw [loop]
    split
    · next hi =>
      have hPali : Pal T i (initRad P C R i) := by
        unfold initRad
        split
        · next hiR =>
          have hCi' : C < i := by
            rcases hCi with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
            · exact h
            · omega
          have hrC : R - C ≤ C := hC.1
          have hR2C : R ≤ 2 * C := by omega
          have hmi : 2 * C - i < i := by omega
          have hmiT : 2 * C - i < T.size := by omega
          have hget : P.getD (2 * C - i) 0 = maxrad T (2 * C - i) := hinv _ hmi
          rw [hget]
          exact pal_mirror hC hCR hCi' hiR (maxrad_spec T (2 * C - i) hmiT).1
        · exact pal_zero T i hi
      have hpm : expand T i (initRad P C R i) = maxrad T i :=
        expand_eq_maxrad _ _ _ hPali
      have hPalp : Pal T i (maxrad T i) := (maxrad_spec T i hi).1
      have hsz' : (setAt P i (expand T i (initRad P C R i))).size = T.size := by
        rw [size_setAt]; exact hsz
      have hinv' : ∀ k, k < i + 1 →
          (setAt P i (expand T i (initRad P C R i))).getD k 0 = maxrad T k := by
        intro k hk
        rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k i with hki | hki
        · rw [getD_setAt_ne _ _ _ _ (by omega)]
          exact hinv k hki
        · have hke : k = i := by omega
          subst hke
          rw [getD_setAt_same _ _ _ (by omega), hpm]
      split
      · next hgt =>
        refine ih _ _ _ _ (by omega) hsz' hinv' ?_ (by omega) (Or.inl (by omega))
        have he : i + expand T i (initRad P C R i) - i = maxrad T i := by
          rw [hpm]; omega
        rw [he]
        exact hPalp
      · next hle =>
        refine ih _ _ _ _ (by omega) hsz' hinv' hC hCR ?_
        rcases hCi with h | ⟨h1, h2⟩
        · exact Or.inl (by omega)
        · exact Or.inr ⟨h1, h2⟩
    · next hi =>
      exact ⟨hsz, fun k hk => hinv k (by omega)⟩

/-! ### Correctness of the maximum search -/

theorem bestOf_spec (P : Array Nat) :
    ∀ n j b, P.size - j ≤ n → b < P.size →
      bestOf P j b < P.size ∧ P.getD b 0 ≤ P.getD (bestOf P j b) 0 ∧
        ∀ k, j ≤ k → k < P.size → P.getD k 0 ≤ P.getD (bestOf P j b) 0 := by
  intro n
  induction n with
  | zero =>
    intro j b hn hb
    rw [bestOf, dif_neg (by omega)]
    exact ⟨hb, le_refl _, fun k hk hk2 => by omega⟩
  | succ n ih =>
    intro j b hn hb
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j P.size with hj | hj
    · rw [bestOf, dif_pos hj]
      by_cases h' : P.getD b 0 < P.getD j 0
      · rw [if_pos h']
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (j + 1) j (by omega) hj
        refine ⟨h1, le_trans (by omega) h2, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hk2
        rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hk with he | hlt
        · subst he; exact h2
        · exact h3 k (by omega) hk2
      · rw [if_neg h']
        obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3⟩ := ih (j + 1) b (by omega) hb
        refine ⟨h1, h2, ?_⟩
        intro k hk hk2
        rcases Nat.eq_or_lt_of_le hk with he | hlt
        · subst he; exact le_trans (by omega) h2
        · exact h3 k (by omega) hk2
    · rw [bestOf, dif_neg (by omega)]
      exact ⟨hb, le_refl _, fun k hk hk2 => by omega⟩

/-! ### From radii in `T` back to substrings of `s` -/

theorem final_core (s : Array UInt8) (T : Array (Option UInt8))
    (hTsz : T.size = 2 * s.size + 1)
    (heven : ∀ x, x < T.size → x % 2 = 0 → T.getD x none = none)
    (hodd : ∀ x, x < T.size → x % 2 = 1 → T.getD x none = some (s.getD (x / 2) 0))
    (b r : Nat) (hbT : b < T.size) (hr : r = maxrad T b)
    (hbest : ∀ k, k < T.size → maxrad T k ≤ r) :
    is_valid_subrange s ((b - r) / 2) r ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s ((b - r) / 2) r ∧
      ∀ q l, is_valid_subrange s q l → is_palindrome_slice s q l → l ≤ r := by
  have hpal : Pal T b r := by rw [hr]; exact (maxrad_spec T b hbT).1
  have hmax : ∀ x, Pal T b x → x ≤ r := by
    intro x hx; rw [hr]; exact (maxrad_spec T b hbT).2 x hx
  have hle : r ≤ b := hpal.1
  have hlt : b + r < T.size := hpal.2.1
  -- the parity of the maximal radius matches the parity of the centre
  have hpar : (b + r) % 2 = 0 := by
    by_contra hodd'
    have hodd1 : (b + r) % 2 = 1 := by omega
    have hstep : Pal T b (r + 1) := by
      refine ⟨by omega, by omega, fun j hj => ?_⟩
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge j (r + 1) with h' | h'
      · exact hpal.2.2 j (by omega)
      · have hje : j = r + 1 := by omega
        subst hje
        rw [heven _ (by omega) (by omega), heven _ (by omega) (by omega)]
    have := hmax (r + 1) hstep
    omega
  have hvalid : (b - r) / 2 + r ≤ s.size := by omega
  have hslice : is_palindrome_slice s ((b - r) / 2) r := by
    intro j hj
    have hp2 : 2 * ((b - r) / 2) = b - r := by omega
    have hx1 : 2 * ((b - r) / 2 + j) + 1 < T.size := by omega
    have hx2 : 2 * ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) + 1 < T.size := by omega
    have e1 : T.getD (2 * ((b - r) / 2 + j) + 1) none = some (s.getD ((b - r) / 2 + j) 0) := by
      have hd : (2 * ((b - r) / 2 + j) + 1) / 2 = (b - r) / 2 + j := by omega
      rw [hodd _ hx1 (by omega), hd]
    have e2 : T.getD (2 * ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) + 1) none
        = some (s.getD ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) 0) := by
      have hd : (2 * ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) + 1) / 2 = (b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j := by omega
      rw [hodd _ hx2 (by omega), hd]
    have key : T.getD (2 * ((b - r) / 2 + j) + 1) none
        = T.getD (2 * ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) + 1) none := by
      rcases Nat.lt_or_ge (2 * j + 1) r with hc | hc
      · have q1 : b - (r - 2 * j - 1) = 2 * ((b - r) / 2 + j) + 1 := by omega
        have q2 : b + (r - 2 * j - 1) = 2 * ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) + 1 := by omega
        rw [← q1, ← q2]
        exact hpal.2.2 _ (by omega)
      · have q1 : b + (2 * j + 1 - r) = 2 * ((b - r) / 2 + j) + 1 := by omega
        have q2 : b - (2 * j + 1 - r) = 2 * ((b - r) / 2 + r - 1 - j) + 1 := by omega
        rw [← q1, ← q2]
        exact (hpal.2.2 _ (by omega)).symm
    rw [e1, e2] at key
    first
    | exact Option.some_inj.mp key
    | exact Option.some_injective _ key
    | (injection key)
  refine ⟨hvalid, hslice, ?_⟩
  intro q l hq hpq
  have hql : q + l ≤ s.size := hq
  have hc : 2 * q + l < T.size := by omega
  have hPalc : Pal T (2 * q + l) l := by
    refine ⟨by omega, by omega, fun j hj => ?_⟩
    by_cases hpj : (l + j) % 2 = 0
    · rw [heven _ (by omega) (by omega), heven _ (by omega) (by omega)]
    · have hpj1 : (l + j) % 2 = 1 := by omega
      have hl1 : 1 ≤ l := by omega
      have hm : (l - j - 1) / 2 < l := by omega
      have hkey := hpq ((l - j - 1) / 2) hm
      have d1 : (2 * q + l - j) / 2 = q + (l - j - 1) / 2 := by omega
      have d2 : (2 * q + l + j) / 2 = q + l - 1 - (l - j - 1) / 2 := by omega
      rw [hodd _ (by omega) (by omega), hodd _ (by omega) (by omega), d1, d2, hkey]
  exact le_trans ((maxrad_spec T (2 * q + l) hc).2 l hPalc) (hbest _ hc)

/-! ### The specification of `solve` -/

theorem solve_spec (s : Array UInt8) :
    let P := loop (mkT s) (Array.ofFn (n := (mkT s).size) fun _ => (0 : Nat)) 0 0 0
    let b := bestOf P 0 0
    is_valid_subrange s ((b - P.getD b 0) / 2) (P.getD b 0) ∧
      is_palindrome_slice s ((b - P.getD b 0) / 2) (P.getD b 0) ∧
      ∀ q l, is_valid_subrange s q l → is_palindrome_slice s q l → l ≤ P.getD b 0 := by
  intro P b
  have hTsz : (mkT s).size = 2 * s.size + 1 := size_mkT s
  have hT0 : 0 < (mkT s).size := by omega
  have hinit : (Array.ofFn (n := (mkT s).size) fun _ => (0 : Nat)).size = (mkT s).size := by
    simp
  obtain ⟨hPsz, hPval⟩ :=
    loop_spec (mkT s) (mkT s).size
      (Array.ofFn (n := (mkT s).size) fun _ => (0 : Nat)) 0 0 0 (by omega) hinit
      (fun k hk => absurd hk (by omega)) (pal_zero _ 0 hT0) (le_refl 0) (Or.inr ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
